an10.95:1.1: atha kho uttiyo paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an10.95:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uttiyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an10.95:1.3: kinnukho bho gotama sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti?
an10.95:2.1: kiṃ pana bho gotama ‘asassato loko, ida meva saccaṃ moghamaññanti’?
an10.95:3.1: kinnu kho bho gotama antavā loko …pe…
an10.95:3.7: hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇā …pe…
an10.95:3.8: neva hoti na nahoti tathāgato parammaraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti?
an10.95:3.10: ‘neva hoti na nahoti tathāgato parammaraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti.
an10.95:4.1: kinnu kho bho gotama sassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti iti puṭṭho samāno ‘avyākataṃ kho etaṃ uttiya mayā
an10.95:4.2: sassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti’ vadesi.
an10.95:5.1: kimpana bho gotama asassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti iti puṭṭho samāno
an10.95:5.2: etampi kho uttiya avyākataṃ mayā ‘asassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti” vadesi.
an10.95:6.1: kinnu kho bho gotama antavā loko …pe…
an10.95:6.7: hoti ca na hoti ca tathāgato parammaraṇā …pe…
an10.95:6.8: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti iti puṭṭho samāno
an10.95:6.10: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti vadesi.
an10.95:7.1: abhiññāya kho ahaṃ uttiya sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desemi sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
an10.95:8.1: yaṃ panetaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo abhiññāya abhiññāya sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya sabbo vā tena loko nīyissati upaḍḍho vā tibhāgo vā ti?
an10.95:9.2: ‘māhevaṃ kho uttiyo paribbājako pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭilabhi.
an10.95:9.3: ‘sabbasāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti, na nūna visahatī’ti.
an10.95:9.4: tadassa uttiyassa paribbājakassa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā’ti.
an10.95:10.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando uttiyaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca:
an10.95:10.2: tena hāvuso uttiya upamaṃ te karissāmi.
an10.95:10.3: upamāya pi idhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
an10.95:10.4: seyyathāpi āvuso uttiya rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷahuddāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ.
an10.95:10.5: tatrassa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā, ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
an10.95:10.6: so tassa nagarassa samantā anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā antamaso biḷāra nikkamanamattampi,
an10.95:10.7: no ca khvassa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti: ettakā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vāti.
an10.95:10.8: atha khvassa evamettha hoti: ye kho keci oḷārikā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā sabbe te iminā dvārena pavisanti ca nikkhamanti cāti.
an10.95:11.1: evameva kho āvuso uttiya na taṃ tathāgatassa evaṃ ussukkataṃ hoti ‘sabbo vā tena loko nīyissati, upaḍḍho vā tibhāgo vā’ti.
an10.95:11.2: atha kho evamettha tathāgatassa hoti: ye kho keci lokamhā nīyiṃsu vā nīyanti vā nīyissanti vā, sabbe te pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catusu satipaṭṭhānesu supaṭṭhitacittā sattabojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā
an10.95:11.3: evamete lokamhā nīyiṃsu vā nīyanti vā nīyissanti vā’ti.
an10.95:11.4: yadeva kho tvaṃ āvuso uttiya bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi tadevetaṃ paññaṃ bhagavantaṃ aññena pariyāyena apucchi.
an10.95:11.5: tasmā te taṃ bhagavā na vyākāsīti.
